fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using scheduled tasks and variable expansion of cleanmgr.exe (UACMe 34)
fields.name: UAC Bypass Using Disk Cleanup
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "\"\\system32\\cleanmgr.exe /autoclean /d C:" and src.process.cmdline="C:\\Windows\\system32\\svchost.exe -k netsvcs -p -s Schedule" and (tgt.process.integrityLevel in ("High","System","S-1-16-16384","S-1-16-12288"))))
